services.value: Provides cleanroom testing and certification services including particle counts, HEPA filter integrity/velocity/volume, viable air and surface sampling, room air changes and pressure, and qualification activities (IQ/OQ/PQ). Also offers environmental monitoring services for cleanroom compliance, including cleanroom qualification, controlled environment monitoring (surface/contact plates/swabs, air particulates/viable particulates), compressed air & gas systems testing, and water testing services.
